pli-tv-bi-vb-pc5:1.1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc5:1.1.2: atha kho mahāpajāpati gotamī yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā adhovāte aṭṭhāsi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc5:1.1.5: ādiyantu kho bhikkhuniyo udakasuddhikanti, mahāpajāpatiṃ gotamiṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc5:1.1.6: atha kho mahāpajāpati gotamī bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassitā samādapitā samuttejitā sampahaṃsitā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc5:1.1.7: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc5:1.2.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarā bhikkhunī
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc5:1.2.2: bhagavatā udakasuddhikā anuññātāti atigambhīraṃ udakasuddhikaṃ ādiyantī muttakaraṇe vaṇaṃ akāsi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc5:1.2.3: atha kho sā bhikkhunī bhikkhunīnaṃ etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc5:1.2.4: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc5:1.2.5: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhunī atigambhīraṃ udakasuddhikaṃ ādiyissatī”ti. …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc5:1.2.6: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhunī atigambhīraṃ udakasuddhikaṃ ādiyīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc5:1.2.9: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhave bhikkhunī atigambhīraṃ udakasuddhikaṃ ādiyissati,
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc5:1.2.11: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc5:1.2.12.1: “udakasuddhikaṃ pana bhikkhuniyā ādiyamānāya dvaṅgulapabbaparamaṃ ādātabbaṃ. taṃ atikkāmentiyā pācittiya”nti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc5:2.1.8: samphassaṃ sādiyanti antamaso kesaggamattampi atikkāmeti āpatti pācittiyassa.
